summary: A benefit-shaped claim must not be scored by ungated cue counting. ClassifyStance routes harm claims through four gates (dedup, framing, negation, pairing) and sent everything else down a baseline that counted every supportCues hit outright; two of those gates belong on the baseline too. A support cue preceded by a negation inside its own sentence is not a report of benefit, and an `increas*` cue only counts when the claim's OUTCOME side is within the cue's pairing window — because in this literature `increas*` usually names the intervention being administered, not an effect that was found. nullCues additionally learns three Cochrane-style hedges. Any regen that restores ungated counting on the benefit branch re-opens the defect.
reason: The baseline read null results as agreement, because the verb naming an INTERVENTION is itself a support cue. Measured on the archived Cochrane omega-3 review (10.1002/14651858.cd003177.pub3, 86 RCTs, 162,796 participants): its abstract says 'little or no effect of increasing LCn3 on all-cause mortality' with high-certainty evidence, and the engine scored it supporting at 0.82 — eleven of its eighteen support cues were the word 'increase' in some form, three of them inside the very sentences announcing the null finding. Across the thirteen archived corpora not one of omega3's forty-four cue-bearing works could ever reach a negative margin, and omega3, probiotics and saffron each carried zero refuting and zero mixed works. Which gates to transfer was measured, not argued, over all 295 works: framing moved nothing at all; dedup moved one work; the full pairing gate moved ninety, pushed sixty-one works into inconclusive (one of them a real null result) and drove the meditation benefit control from +0.91/evidence-supports to -0.71/evidence-refutes. Three properties are load-bearing and easy to lose in a regen. First, 'unclear' must stay OUT of nullCues: it expresses uncertainty rather than a null finding, and adding it flipped two zero-cue works in the calibrated harm controls straight to refuting/0.90 — nullCues feeds the harm branch's negative count as well, so anything added there has to be re-measured against those controls. Second, the outcome-scope test needs a claim splitter that works on benefit-shaped claims; the production claimSides keys on claimHarmCues alone and returns nothing for 'X improves Y', and a splitter that stops at the benefit cues is still inert on any claim whose verb is a bare 'reduces' (the benefit cues require the literal word 'risk'). Third, the scope test requires only the claim's outcome side, not both sides: a benefit-shaped abstract names its intervention in nearly every sentence, so demanding both is the full pairing gate and carries its damage. A known limit is recorded rather than fixed: the same defect class covers prevent*, reduc*, improv* and four more intent verbs — 239 of 605 support cues on the benefit-path works, spread over 80 works — but excluding them by scope cannot reach a title like 'Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold', where the claim's own outcome sits beside the verb. Separating an intent from a finding there needs grammatical mood, which is a different change.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test green across the module; govulncheck reports 0 reachable vulnerabilities; verify_skill.py passes. New suite pinned over all 13 archived corpora (295 works, corpora_full): Consensus reproduces every archived score and verdict from the archived stances, 13 of 13. Control group unmoved — 108 works across the six calibrated harm corpora, zero movement, which is also what keeps 'unclear' out of nullCues. The meditation benefit control is re-scored through the live classifier and holds at +0.91/evidence-supports with counts 5-0-1-4; corpus_regression_test.go asserts that corpus against archived json and therefore cannot catch a stance.go change on its own, so the new test closes that hole. Two target works move by DOI: the Cochrane omega-3 review 10.1002/14651858.cd003177.pub3 supporting/0.82 -> mixed/0.52, and 10.1111/irv.12615, an RCT whose abstract states the supplementation 'did not reduce' infections, supporting/0.70 -> refuting/0.90. Corpus effect: omega3 +1.00 -> +0.96 with near_unanimous clearing, saffron +1.00 -> +0.89 with near_unanimous clearing, vitamind +0.98 -> +0.73, melatonin +0.84 -> +0.78, vitaminc +0.70 -> +0.67; no corpus changes verdict. Fourteen works change label in total. Exactly five move supporting -> inconclusive and the suite asserts them by DOI and asserts that none carries null-result vocabulary, so a future widening that starts swallowing dissent fails rather than passing quietly. One recorded fixture narrowed: the retracted COVID green-foods review keeps its supporting stance but drops 0.95 -> 0.9, because the outcome-scope gate removes its intestinal-bacteria cue; none of the four cues the old 0.95 rested on sat in a sentence naming the common cold, which occurs once in that text against five occurrences of covid. That fixture's confidence assertion was also moved from exact float equality to approxEq.
